data.narrative:
Type One Energy is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by David Anderson, Chris Hegna, and John Canik that has raised $100M+. The broader nuclear energy sector includes three public comparables (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and eight private peers including Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, and Valar Atomics.

Stage-progression methodology applies to this valuation. Using the $100M total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B to next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $190M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient comparables meeting narrow stage and tier filters within nuclear energy—while four same-sector peers exist, none of the stage-adjacent or valuation-tier subsets contained the three or more datapoints required for reliable median estimation.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $162M (low) to $218M (high), with a median point of $190M. This range is derived from a single applicable methodology, which represents a material limitation. Key uncertainties include the lack of sufficiently granular peer data to validate stage-progression assumptions specific to the nuclear subsector, and the undisclosed nature of Type One Energy's current valuation and specific operational metrics. A more robust triangulation would require additional same-stage private nuclear comparables or broader sector revenue/technology milestone data.
